title: pvEvenlySpacedStreamlines2D
body:
## pvEvenlySpacedStreamlines2D

Fills a 2-D vector field with streamlines at roughly uniform spacing (Jobard–Lefer algorithm): starting at StartPosition it integrates forward and backward, seeds new lines SeparatingDistance beside existing ones, and stops a line when it comes closer than SeparatingDistance × SeparatingDistanceRatio to another, closes a loop, leaves the domain, slows below TerminalSpeed or reaches MaximumSteps. Input must lie in the x-y plane with in-plane point vectors; output is polylines with IntegrationTime, interpolated fields and a ReasonForTermination cell array. Use it for even flow pictures of 2-D slices; streamTracer seeds from a chosen source.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A slice not lying in the x-y plane gives wrong or no streamlines; transform it into x-y first.
- With the default Cell Length unit, distances are multiples of the diagonal of the cell containing StartPosition, so moving the seed rescales all spacings; choose Length for dataset units.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `EvenlySpacedStreamlines2D`. Identity: `filters/EvenlySpacedStreamlines2D`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array with 3 components. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ClosedLoopMaximumDistance` | Loops are considered closed if the have two points at distance less than this. This is expressed in IntegrationStepUnit. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `ComputeVorticity` | Specify whether to compute vorticity. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `InitialStepLength` | This property specifies the initial integration step size. For non-adaptive integrators (Runge-Kutta 2 and Runge-Kutta 4), it is fixed (always equal to this initial value) throughout the integration. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `IntegrationStepUnit` | This property specifies the unit for Initial integration step size. The Length unit refers to the arc length that a particle travels/advects within a single step. The Cell Length unit represents the step size as a number of cells. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Length","Cell Length"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Length"` |
| `IntegratorType` | This property determines which integrator (with increasing accuracy) to use for creating streamlines. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Runge-Kutta 2","Runge-Kutta 4"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Runge-Kutta 2"` |
| `InterpolatorType` | This property determines which interpolator to use for evaluating the velocity vector field. The first is faster though the second is more robust in locating cells during streamline integration. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Interpolator with Point Locator","Interpolator with Cell Locator"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Interpolator with Point Locator"` |
| `MaximumSteps` | This property specifies the maximum number of steps, beyond which streamline integration is terminated. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `SeparatingDistance` | Specify the separating distance between streamlines expressed in IntegrationStepUnit. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `SeparatingDistanceRatio` | Specifies SeparatingDistanceRatio. If streamlines get closer than SeparatingDistance * SeparatingDistanceRatio to other streamlines integration stops. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `StartPosition` | Specify the starting point (seed) of the first streamline in the global coordinate system. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `TerminalSpeed` | This property specifies the terminal speed, below which particle advection/integration is terminated. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Vectors` | This property contains the name of the vector array from which to generate streamlines. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
